An SAE was defined as any untoward medical occurrence that, at any dose, met one or more of the following criteria: resulted in death, was life-threatening, required inpatient hospitalization or prolongation of existing hospitalization, resulted in persistent or significant disability/incapacity, was a congenital anomaly/birth defect, was a suspected transmission via a Pfizer product of an infectious agent, pathogenic or nonpathogenic, or other situations.

analysis_trace: Trial identification: NCT05989048 is a Phase III trial of zavegepant nasal spray for acute migraine treatment in Asian adults. Two primary endpoints: pain freedom at 2 hours (primary-0) and MBS freedom at 2 hours (primary-1).

Patient population: Asian adults with acute migraine. This is a specific geographic/ethnic subgroup; efficacy data from general adult populations may not fully transfer due to potential PK/PD differences.
Target mechanism: Zavegepant is a CGRP receptor antagonist (gepant class). Mechanism well-established for acute migraine.

Evidence retrieved: Crossref results show zavegepant 10mg nasal spray demonstrated efficacy in acute migraine (2023 conference reports), long-term safety data (2024), and PK modeling (2024). However, specific Asian population Phase III data not found.
Endpoint interpretation: Both endpoints are standard for acute migraine trials (2-hour pain freedom, 2-hour MBS freedom). These match the regulatory pathway used for gepant approvals.

Evidence fit: Retrieved sources show zavegepant efficacy in general migraine populations (indirect_direction). No direct numeric match for Asian-specific Phase III. Mismatch: population (general vs Asian adults). Numeric use not allowed for exact rate prediction.
Safety analysis: Long-term safety study (2024) showed acceptable tolerability. No new safety signals identified in available data.
Key risks: 1) Ethnic variation in response may affect Asian population specifically; 2) Nasal spray formulation absorption variability; 3) Regulatory acceptance of single-region Asian data.

Evidence to prediction: Based on gepant class efficacy (rimegepant, ubrogepant approved) and zavegepant Phase 2/3 data in general population, high probability of success. However, confidence reduced due to lack of Asian-specific efficacy data.
Coverage gaps: No direct Phase III results for NCT05989048; no Asian-specific efficacy rates published; registry record unavailable.

matches.human_readable_report: NCT05989048 是 zavegepant 鼻喷 10 mg 对比安慰剂治疗亚洲成人急性偏头痛的 III 期试验，OG000=zavegepant、OG001=placebo，合同共 27 个终点：两条主终点加 25 个次要终点（15/30/60 分钟与 2 小时的 pain relief/freedom、2-24/2-48 小时持续缓解、恐声/畏光/恶心 freedom、复发、补救用药、以及治疗期/随访期安全计数）。kimi 模型只输出了两条主终点。primary-0（2 小时无痛 freedom）质量很好：22.0%（CI 18-28）对 Gold OG000 23.2（20.0-26.4）仅差 1.2 个百分点且区间覆盖，是七例中最准的单点之一；primary-1（MBS freedom）则明显失准：35.0（CI 28-42）对 Gold 52.7 低估 17.7 个百分点、安慰剂 18.0 对 39.9 低估 21.9 个百分点，亚洲人群 MBS 应答显著更高的现象未被预测，而模型 trace 自己提出了亚洲 PK/PD 差异风险却没落实到数值。其余 25 个终点全部缺失：起效曲线（15 分钟 14.5 对 10.9 等）、持续缓解（55.8 对 39.8 等）、伴随症状（恐声 52.1 对 36.3 等）、补救用药（17.1 对 24.4）、以及最有鉴别度的安全信号——治疗期局部刺激 41 对 6 的事件数——无一覆盖。过程层面：检索只有 1 条查询，审计 5 次调用 3 次阻断（registry 403、PubMed 非 JSON）、3 次空结果、返回仅 12 条；5 条 verification DOI（2023-01-05 至 2024-11-03）全部真实且未越 cutoff 2026-01-31（max_doc 2025-11-18）；trace 的 Coverage gaps 声明诚实（no Asian-specific efficacy rates published、registry record unavailable），无幻觉迹象。值得肯定的是 uncertainty 披露与 evidence role 标注（indirect_direction）规范，长期安全与 PK 文献虽被检索到却未转化为任何预测，属证据空转。综合判断：单点准、覆盖差，输出契约履行率仅 7%，是典型的窄带宽样本。
matches.judge_comments: 对 NCT05989048 的复核意见：这份样本呈现出强烈的两极性——primary-0 的 22.0 对 Gold 23.2 几乎命中，说明模型对 gepant 类效应的量化能力真实存在；但它只交付了 2/27 个终点，25 个次要终点连 abstain 理由都没有，按合同衡量是本批覆盖最差的输出。primary-1 的失败模式值得记录：trace 明确写了亚洲人群 PK/PD 差异风险，数值却直接沿用一般人群外推（35.0 对实际 52.7），自我声明的风险没有进入量化修正，属于声明-数值脱节。检索侧仅 1 条查询配 3 次阻断，几乎没有自适应重试，导致疗效曲线与安全谱证据零积累；好在引用的 5 条 DOI 全部真实合规，无幻觉。若下游使用该样本，只能采信其 primary-0 一点，其余维度需视为缺失而非错误。

gold_value.measure: Percentage of Participants With Pain Freedom at 2 Hours Post-dose
gold_value.analysis_population: Efficacy analysis set included all enrolled participants, who (1) were randomized only once, (2) had a migraine of moderate or severe pain intensity at the time of dosing, (3) took study intervention (Zavegepant or Placebo), and (4) had post-dose efficacy data.

endpoint_reviews.value_assessment: 模型 primary-0 给 zavegepant 22.0%（CI 18-28）、placebo 8.0%；Gold 为 OG000 23.2（CI 20.0-26.4）、OG001 14.1（CI 11.4-16.7）。药臂仅低 1.2 个百分点且 CI 18-28 覆盖 23.2，安慰剂低 6.1 个百分点。
endpoint_reviews.direction_assessment: 方向正确：模型 zavegepant 22.0 高于 placebo 8.0，与 Gold OG000 23.2 高于 OG001 14.1 的排序一致，治疗差异方向无误。
endpoint_reviews.group_timepoint_assessment: 模型两组 Zavegepant/Placebo 映射 OG000/OG001，At 2 hours post-dose 时间点两侧一致，mITT estimand 与 Gold 口径对应良好。
endpoint_reviews.reason:
证据：primary-0 是 2 小时无痛 freedom 率，模型 effect_point=22.0、CI 18-28、组行 22.0/8.0（denominator 100）；Gold OG000 23.2（20.0-26.4）、OG001 14.1（11.4-16.7）。
优点与不足：优点是药臂 22.0 与 Gold 23.2 仅差 1.2 个百分点且 CI 覆盖；不足是安慰剂 8.0 较 14.1 低 6.1 个百分点，治疗组间差异被高估（模型 14 个百分点对 Gold 9.1 个百分点）。
评分档位依据：基准 100，扣 12（安慰剂低估 6.1 个百分点）、扣 8（组间差异放大），100 - 12 - 8 = 80。
